component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Calculates clusters and visualizes them in heatmap.
Input data are scaled row-wise, then the Euclidean method for distance calculation and Ward method for clustering are used to assign these rows into predetermined number of clusters. The recommended use of this metanode is first running it with the number of clusters set to 1 and then adjusting and reruning this metanode based on the input.
Clustering cannot be calculated for rows with any missing data. This metanode therefore either filters out all rows with missing values prior to clustering, or user can choose a simple method of imputation. More advanced imputation methods need to be performed prior to running this metanode.
